name: Qatar Navigation Q.P.S.C.
summary: Qatar Navigation Q.P.S.C. operates as a maritime and logistics company in Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Singapore, Germany, India, Malta, and Luxembourg. The company operates through five segments: Milaha Capital, Milaha Maritime & Logistics, Milaha Offshore, Milaha Trading, and Milaha Gas and Petrochem. The Milaha Capital segment provides corporate finance advisory services; and manages the portfolio of financial and real estate investments.
